evidence:
PASS on source inspection plus partial scripted runtime evidence. Risk stays true because no indexed run executes solve.sh in the agent image or launches the installed result through the frozen test.sh; no Oracle or full verifier run exists, and I started no container.

solve.sh (task/solution/solve.sh, sha256 1df2ed04... equal to the raw-evidence index and to the project copy):
- line 1 '#!/bin/bash', line 2 'set -euo pipefail'; 'bash -n' passes; 0 CR bytes (LF only).
- line 3 'mkdir -p /app' and line 35 'cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/' are the two template commands (template solve.sh lines 4-5), so /app/server.js is created from solution/app/server.js.
- Only /app is written. Line 36 'rm -f -- "$database_path" "$database_path-wal" "$database_path-shm"' is confined to /app by the case guard on lines 6-9. A grep for pkill, NODE_ENV, /tests, /logs, /solution, 'npm ' and nproc returns nothing; there is no solve-time install or fetch.
- Lines 12-34 scan /proc for open handles on the database, but line 16 exits 0 when no database file exists, which is the oracle state: the agent image /app holds only .gitkeep and .git (environment/Dockerfile:17-23) and solution/ ships no *.db.

Reference under the stated contract (instruction.md:15, integration.md:3-10, test.sh:97-111, test.sh byte-identical to the template):
- Entry: solution/app/server.js:2 "require('./src/index.js')", so 'node /app/server.js' is the start command; node --check passes on all nine JS files (host Node v24.19.0, syntax only).
- Port: src/bootstrap.js:43 "server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0'"; the worker gets PORT '0' and binds 127.0.0.1 behind the proxy (bootstrap.js:45, index.js:463-464).
- Health: bootstrap.js:20-24 answers GET/HEAD /api/health in the main thread before the worker opens SQLite.
- Storage: src/db.js:13 "process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(__dirname, '..', 'app.db')" resolves to /app/app.db by default and honours DB_PATH; db.js:23 creates the parent directory.
- Seeding: db.js:123-124 returns when users is non-empty, inside one transaction, so restarts do not duplicate.
- Self-contained: db.js:14 prefers the co-located src/seed_data.json, which is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (cmp), so the app does not need /assets at runtime (instruction.md:17). Requires are node built-ins, express and better-sqlite3 only; both are pinned globally in the agent and verifier images with NODE_PATH (environment/Dockerfile:3,9-11; tests/Dockerfile:9,20-21). public/index.html loads only /styles.css and /js/*.js; no http(s) URL appears in public/ or in server code. solution/ has 14 regular files, no symlinks, node_modules or database.
- Unprivileged launch: test.sh:87 chowns /app to 65534 and injects DB_PATH=/app/app.db, where WAL side files (db.js:25) are writable.

Run evidence (raw-evidence-index.json; all ten artifact hashes recomputed and matching, solution hashes match frozen bytes): live-desk.cjs:14 spawns 'node /app/server.js' with env limited to PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT=3000 and DB_PATH=/tmp/hireops-live-desk.db in the verifier image; results/server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice (start and restart); results/live-desk.json records 11/11 passed including 'process restart keeps saved changes; retry returns the original receipt'. This confirms start command, port, health, a non-default DB_PATH and restart persistence. It does not cover solve.sh execution, the default /app/app.db path, or the setpriv/env -i launch in test.sh, and it is not a judge or Oracle run.

Latent observations, not failures of this row (P3):
1. solve.sh departs from the two-line template with the /proc scan and database removal. On a reinstall with an existing database, run as non-root beside other users' processes, readdir of /proc/<pid>/fd returns EACCES and line 22 aborts the install. Unreachable on a fresh oracle install.
2. solve.sh line 5 reads DB_PATH; a harness-set DB_PATH outside /app would exit 1 at line 8. Nothing in task.toml sets it for the agent phase.
3. The private check-solve-contract.py was not executed; its documented behaviour was applied by hand.
4. solve.sh is mode 100644 in the git index, same as the template's solve.sh and test.sh.
